description: Experience the ultimate car wash with SONAX XTREME Rich Foam Shampoo, a professional grade formula combining high performance with vehicle-care safety. Developed and manufactured in Germany, this foam shampoo produces an opulent, long-lasting foam that gently removes contaminants while adding gloss to all painted, plastic, glass, rubber and wrapped surfaces. Its pH neutral formulation ensures compatibility with waxes, ceramic coatings, PPF and matte finishes—never compromising your vehicle’s protective treatment. How to Use: Foam Cannon/Gun: Pre rinse vehicle, dilute 30–100 ml per 1 L water in the lance. Apply rich foam carpet, let dwell briefly, then rinse thoroughly. Manual Bucket/Sponge: Dilute 50 ml per 10 L of warm water. Wash top-to-bottom and rinse immediately before drying. For best results, detail in shaded or cool environments and avoid direct sunlight to prevent premature drying. Real Benefits: Enhances gloss, restores color depth and delivers professional level results with minimal effort Provides outstanding lubrication, reducing swirl marks while washing Fresh berry aroma makes washing enjoyable Available in convenient 1 L and 5 L pack sizes—make your vehicle shine effortlessly with each wash.
